name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.113.0 — The theme pick moves to /spec:sketch's new first-run Theme step — the mocks driver's theme state/compose/open/adopt subcommand family lives outside the mocks state machine, candidates are the signed-off gray kit re-rendered per direction at design/theme/<kebab>/kit.html, and the picked direction's kit page becomes the fidelity reference every later sketch surface is built from; theme adopt supersedes rather than refuses, marking every other confirmed theme: row overridden so exactly one confirmed pick survives across all directions and a later genesis brief is never grounded on two contradictory picks [no-ac: review's version-bump check is the oracle]. 7.112.0 — The release stage's e2e leg now reds on an unobserved run — an observed zero executed count, or a declared count format that never matched — and the journeys leg reds when zero journeys were walked; the count parsers plus the unobserved predicate now live in one shared module that both review-legs.js and release-legs.js import instead of each declaring their own. 7.111.0 — token-cost trims for Fable 5.1 seats: core § Session Execution (edit-don't-rewrite, act on enough information, no extras, batch calls) served by every shared-for list; shared-for gains init (no more whole-doctrine fail-open) and run-design (the delta /spec:run's Design stage loads; build/review stages skip their own shared-for); shared-genesis/shared-mocks --section slice one supplement section and both drivers print the slice per step, so the 50 KB / 23 KB supplements are never read whole; shared-for stops echoing frontmatter; the plugin description's changelog paragraphs are one line each. Published as 7.111.0 after a concurrent session claimed 7.110.0.
